title: Protect from runtime error if Item Availability looses date filter
summary: The Sales Order Agent's multi-item availability page now guards against runtime errors when the date filter is missing by checking that the filter exists before comparing shipment dates.
key_points: Prevents runtime error when Date Filter is absent from the SOA Multi Items Availability page
Checks that Date Filter is nonempty before calling GetRangeMax
Preserves existing behavior when the date filter is present
No changes to schema, permissions, or upgrade logic
